widgets.root: Root cause (all lessons): the practice-studio builder keeps each exit-ticket/connect.check follow-up question but drops the shared `scenario` that the questions depend on, so the stem reaches the student with no givens. Fix once in the builder (scripts/generate-practice-studios.mjs mastery assembly): prefix every follow-up stem with the scenario, or render the scenario as a passage above the item. The chemist scenario (5/6 L of solution, 1/12 L per DNA test) is absent, so neither the equation nor 'reasonable' can be judged.
widgets.replacement: 5.1 stem: 'A chemist has 5/6 liter of solution and each DNA test uses 1/12 liter. Which equation finds how many tests she can run?' 5.3 stem: 'She finds that 5/6 ÷ 1/12 = 10 tests. Is 10 tests a reasonable answer?' Keep choices and keys.
